import QuantConnect as QC

class SP500Baseline(QC.Algorithm.QCAlgorithm):

        Initialize the algorithm with a long-only strategy on E-mini S&P 500 futures.
        Handles contract rolls automatically for the September to December 2024 window.

        # Initialize the portfolio
        self.Portfolio = self.Portfolio
        
        # Strategy parameters

        self.LongOnly = True

        self.Log(f"Start Date: {self.SetStartDate()}")

        Execute the trading logic on every data bar.
        Maintains a long position in the E-mini S&P 500 future.
        """

        if self.SP500 is None:

        # Get the current price of the SP500 future
        current_price = self.SP500.LastPrice
        
        # Determine the target position size
        # Since we want a baseline long exposure, we simply hold 1 contract.
        # QuantConnect's futures handling automatically rolls the contract 
        # to the next month when the current contract expires or becomes illiquid.
        # For the Sep-Dec 2024 window, it will roll from Sep -> Oct -> Nov -> Dec.
        
        # Calculate the order quantity (positive for long)
        order_quantity = self.Quantity
        
        # Check if we are currently holding the desired position
        current_position = self.Portfolio.Positions[self.SP500.Symbol]
        
        if current_position is None:
            # No position exists, open a long position
            self.Log(f"Opening Long Position at {current_price}")
            self.SetHoldings(self.SP500.Symbol, order_quantity)
        elif current_position.Quantity != order_quantity:
            # Position size has changed (e.g., due to roll or adjustment), update it
            self.Log(f"Adjusting Position from {current_position.Quantity} to {order_quantity}")
            self.SetHoldings(self.SP500.Symbol, order_quantity)
        else:
            # Position is already at the target level, do nothing
            pass

        # Log current status periodically
        if self.Time.Minute % 60 == 0:
            self.Log(f"Time: {self.Time}, Price: {current_price}, Position: {current_position.Quantity if current_position else 0}")

        self.SP500 = QC.Data.Universe.Resolution.Minute.Bars("SP", QC.Data.Universe.Resolution.Minute)

        self.Portfolio = self.Portfolio
        
        # Strategy parameters

        self.Log(f"Start Date: {self.SetStartDate()}")
        self.Log(f"End Date: {self.SetEndDate()}")
        self.Log(f"Initial Cash: ${self.SetCash()}")
        self.Log("Strategy: Long Exposure to E-mini S&P 500 Futures")
        self.Log("Contract Roll: Automatic (handled by QuantConnect)")

    def OnData(self, data):
        """
        Execute the trading logic on every data bar.
        Maintains a long position in the E-mini S&P 500 future.
        """
        # Check if we have data for the SP500 symbol
        if self.SP500 is None:
            return

        current_price = self.SP500.LastPrice

        # to the next month when the current contract expires or becomes illiquid.
